purpose: Prevent scheduler wake activity from being mistaken for durable progress and prevent silent window stalls.

requirements: window is not current authorized source/role or no material work is due
self-backup or compact wake receipt records why no mutation was legal
exact missing capability or failed operation recorded
current authority and verified baseline preserved
same existing window remains eligible for retry

navigator_rules.progress_requires: durable receipt plus expected source-chain/formal-state delta and readback
navigator_rules.same_root_cause: increment recurrence counter in Home R00
navigator_rules.repair_policy: reuse same existing window/task; do not create duplicate slot

metabolism.wake_receipts: latest-only per window unless referenced by a verified incident/evidence

heartbeat_boundary.rule: Do not interpret this protocol as a real 5-minute always-on runner.
